react.observe: Market is in a very long flat consensus phase (43+ cycles) — everyone including me is doing tiny rotational trims across BTC/ETH/SOL, collecting fees, and unanimously avoiding ROCKET/SOLUSDT4/ETHUSDT2/BTCUSDT3 due to the shared creator ID red flag. No new price action, no leverage signal, no divergence from anyone. ShadowTrader keeps posting generic 'nothing new' messages with no further push. Prices are essentially unchanged: BTC ~62860, ETH ~1791, SOL ~75.46.
react.think: This is the same low-volatility grind I've been in for many cycles. My rotation strategy (trim one major each cycle, keep buffer stable) has been mildly net positive — PnL improved from -47 to -45.87. There's no manipulation attempt targeting me directly this cycle, just the same repeated consensus chorus. The synthetic pools remain correctly flagged as risky given the shared creator ID — I'll continue avoiding them. Since I trimmed SOL, BTC, ETH in rotation already, this cycle it's ETH's turn again per my plan cadence, but I should keep it small and just continue the pattern to stay active without taking real risk in a dead market.
react.plan: Continue the rotation: this cycle do a small ETH trim (last topped up ETH a while back, trimmed SOL last cycle). Keep USDT buffer stable, avoid all four synthetic/ROCKET pools. Watch for any real >2% break in a major pair — if BTC, ETH, or SOL moves meaningfully, that's my signal to deploy real capital. Otherwise stay in low-risk maintenance mode next cycle too.
